text:
alex_support: Customer BoltFin (ticket #6123) reports duplicate function_call events in streaming completions when using structured output + tool calls. They see the same fncall twice in sequence and their webhook rejects it. They started seeing it after we changed streaming flush behavior.

nina_sales: BoltFin is on Dedicated eu-central and this blocks their payment flow. They asked for a short-term mitigation and a clear plan to remove dupes.

tom_product: Can we get a small repro snippet and the webhook error payload? Need to confirm whether duplicates are truly emitted or client replays.

alex_support: Repro attached from customer's capture: ```
[chunk 1] {"type":"delta","content":"..."}
[chunk 2] {"type":"tool_event","name":"charge_card","payload":"{\"amount\":100}"}
[chunk 3] {"type":"tool_event","name":"charge_card","payload":"{\"amount\":100}"}
[chunk 4] {"type":"delta","content":"done"}
// webhook logs: 409 DuplicateEvent: event id already processed
```

diego_eng: Hmm. Two likely causes: emitter race causing duplicate push of the same event id, or retries from the streaming proxy when acks are slow. Related to recent change: we switched to eager flush on kvcache invalidation.

tom_product: Immediate mitigation ideas:
1) Server-side de-dup filter for tool_event ids in a short window (hotfix toggleable)
2) Add a header that guarantees "idempotent" streaming semantics (server will attach stable event ids and dedupe)
3) SDK guidance: client-side resilient webhook handler (idempotency keys)

nina_sales: BoltFin wants 1 + 2. They prefer a server-side toggle they can enable until we ship a more robust fix.

zoe_pm: We need to pick a path and create launch criteria. If we do 1 (dedupe filter) as hotfix, estimate? Diego?

diego_eng: Dedupe short-window (in-memory LRU by event id) -> ~1.5 dev-days + 0.5 QA + 0.5 rollout. Header approach (stable ids + contract) -> 2.5 dev-days + 1 QA. Root-cause (fix emitter flush logic) -> 4-7 dev-days with regression tests.

tom_product: Proposed acceptance for hotfix (dedupe):
- unit tests for duplicate sequences
- integration test with streaming proxy verifying single delivery
- BoltFin validation on staging (they confirm webhook no longer rejects)
- Canary 5% traffic for 4 hours monitored for 5xx/duplicate errors
- Runtime toggle to disable dedupe if unintended side-effects

deploy-bot: maintenance-window-check: eu-central tonight 01:00 UTC -> ok

alex_support: BoltFin engineer can run staging test at 22:00 UTC tonight. Will coordinate.

nina_sales: We'll ask them to stand by. Also prepare a customer-facing note explaining weare enabling a temporary dedupe guard and plan to follow-up with protocol changes.

tom_product: Decision: ship hotfix 1 (dedupe filter) behind runtime flag + follow with header/stable-id design next sprint. @diego_eng assign?

diego_eng: Assigning to ivy_eng. Filing GH: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/9942 title: "hotfix(streaming): temporary dedupe filter for tool_event frames". Starting tonight.

ivy_eng: Got it. Plan: implement LRU dedupe keyed by event-id header (X-Event-Id if present) or internal id. Add metrics: dedupe.count and dedupe.falsepositives.alert. Will open PR and attach staging URL.

zoe_pm: I'll own rollout checklist and customer comms draft. Staging validation must be green before canary.

alex_support: I'll update ticket #6123 and post BoltFin's staging result here.

nina_sales: Thanks team. Also track this as "customer-blocker" in roadmap board and escalate if canary shows any anomalies.

deploy-bot: deploy-plan-created: https://deploys.internal/plan/67910

diego_eng: Follow-up: added item to current sprint under "streaming hotfixes" lane.

ivy_eng: Starting implementation now. Will ping with PR and staging endpoint.

alex_support: Standing by for staging link and will coordinate BoltFin test.
